title: Fact
description: A single thing known about a subject, decaying on its own half-life.

subject_id.description: ID of the person (or other subject) this fact is about.

key.description: Short label used to detect updates to the same fact, e.g. 'dog_surgery'.

value.description: The fact itself, in natural language.

value_embedding.description: Vector embedding of `value`, for semantic recall.

half_life_days.description: How fast this specific fact's relevance decays.

superseded_by.description: ID of the fact that replaced this one, if any.
